title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.21
subtitle: Local Wind by default, with clearer controls and progress.

highlights.title: Wind always acts locally
highlights.description: The global/local toggle is gone. Move and rotate the Empty, then use Radius and Falloff to shape the field.

highlights.title: Organized Wind controls
highlights.description: Adjust field shape, gusts and turbulence, obstacle response, preview quality and air response in clearly grouped controls.

highlights.title: Visible preparation progress
highlights.description: The Bake window reports local Wind sampling and encoding progress instead of staying at zero during preparation.
